params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly addresses the SonarQube warning by introducing constants for duplicated string literals longer than 4 characters and replacing all occurrences with these constants. The changes are focused solely on fixing the duplication issue without altering any unrelated code or functionality. There are no unnecessary modifications, no changes to variable names beyond the constants, and no additions or deletions unrelated to the fix. The patch cleanly improves maintainability and aligns with the recommended best practice.
